subject: Invoice #A-77 for catering services
body: Dear client, attached is invoice #A-77 for the catering at your event on 18 October. Amount: €420.00, due in 15 days. Kind regards, Sabores do Norte

subject: Pagamento parcial da fatura 512
body: Boa tarde, recebemos apenas 300 € dos 900 € da fatura 512, que venceu a 10 de outubro. Pedimos que regularizem o valor em falta.

subject: Price increase from 1 January
body: Dear customer, due to higher raw material costs, our prices will increase by 5% from 1 January. Current orders are not affected. No action is needed on your side.
note: Supplier announcement about prices, but not a bill.

subject: Need 5 more boxes for Thursday's order
body: Hi, our order is scheduled to ship on Thursday. Could you add 5 more boxes of A4 paper? Please confirm by tomorrow so we can update our budget.

subject: Can we schedule a call next week?
body: Hello, we're interested in becoming a reseller of your products in Galicia. Would you have 30 minutes for a call next week?

subject: Produto com defeito
body: Olá, o aspirador que comprei faz um barulho estranho desde o primeiro dia. Gostaria que o trocassem por um novo.

subject: This is the last time we order from you
body: The delivery was three days late again. We are moving to another supplier from next month unless you can guarantee delivery dates in writing.

subject: Your password was changed
body: This is an automated message. The password for your supplier portal account was changed today. If this wasn't you, contact support.
note: Automated security notice; could be argued as higher urgency.

subject: Application for the Junior Developer position
body: Dear hiring team, please find attached my CV for the Junior Developer position advertised on your website. I look forward to hearing from you. Best, Tiago
note: Not a customer email at all.

subject: Thanks for the quick fix!
body: Just wanted to say thanks, the replacement part arrived yesterday and everything works perfectly now.
note: Positive follow-up to a past complaint.

subject: envio
body: quanto custa o envio p espanha?

subject: URGENT!!! read now
body: Make €3,000 a week from home with our new crypto system. Only 10 places left, act within the next hour!

subject: Duplicate charge on my card
body: Hi, I was charged twice for invoice 3381 (€89.00). Could you please refund the duplicate payment?
note: About a payment (invoice) but also a complaint and a request.

subject: Delivery today?
body: Our order was supposed to arrive today and our shop opens tomorrow morning with empty shelves. Please tell us where it is as soon as possible.
note: Could also be read as a customer_request for information.

subject: Reunião de equipa adiada
body: Olá a todos, a reunião de equipa desta quinta-feira foi adiada para a próxima terça às 10h. Obrigada!

subject: Fatura com NIF da empresa
body: Bom dia, podem emitir a fatura da encomenda 4471 com o NIF da nossa empresa? Precisamos dela até ao fim da semana para a contabilidade.

subject: Wrong product delivered
body: We ordered 20 black chairs and received 20 white ones. We have an event the day after tomorrow, so we need the correct chairs by tomorrow.
